Label.NoPartyMembers: No active party or no character members.

Overview.CalloutOk: This character passes all enabled audits.
Overview.CalloutError: Errors detected — review the list below.

Notice.NotCharacter: PF2e Character Audit only supports actors of type "character".

MISSING_ANCESTRY.Title: Missing Ancestry
MISSING_ANCESTRY.Hint: Drag an Ancestry item onto this actor.

MISSING_HERITAGE.Title: Missing Heritage
MISSING_HERITAGE.Hint: Choose a heritage for this actor.

MISSING_BACKGROUND.Title: Missing Background
MISSING_BACKGROUND.Hint: Drag a Background item onto this actor.

MISSING_CLASS.Title: Missing Class
MISSING_CLASS.Hint: Drag a Class item onto this actor.

MISSING_KEY_ABILITY.Title: Key Ability not selected
MISSING_KEY_ABILITY.Hint: Select a Key Ability for the class.

CLASS_SUBCLASS_MISSING.Title: {className} missing {feature}
CLASS_SUBCLASS_MISSING.Hint: This class requires a subclass selection at level 1 (e.g. a Bard's muse, a Cleric's doctrine, a Barbarian's instinct). Drag the corresponding subclass feat onto the actor.

ANCESTRY_FLAW_MISMATCH.Title: Ancestry flaw mismatch
ANCESTRY_FLAW_MISMATCH.Hint: Ancestry has mandatory flaws but build.flaws is empty ({actual}/{expected}).

APEX_MISSING_AT_17.Title: Missing Apex item at level {level}
APEX_MISSING_AT_17.Hint: 17+ characters should have an apex item (unless ABP is on).

LANGUAGE_OVER_LIMIT.Title: Extra languages exceed limit
LANGUAGE_OVER_LIMIT.Hint: Beyond ancestry-granted languages, at most {max} extra are allowed; {actual} extra are selected (total {total}).

LANGUAGE_UNDER_LIMIT.Title: Extra language slots unused
LANGUAGE_UNDER_LIMIT.Hint: Beyond ancestry-granted languages, {max} extra can be picked; {actual} are selected (total {total}).

ARCHETYPE_FEAT_MISSING.Title: Free Archetype feat missing through level {level}

DEDICATION_2_FEAT_RULE.Title: Dedication rule unmet: {dedication}
DEDICATION_2_FEAT_RULE.Hint: After taking a dedication you must take 2 archetype feats before another dedication (have {actual}).

DUAL_CLASS_DETECTED.Title: Dual Class variant active
DUAL_CLASS_DETECTED.Hint: Shallow check only in v1; enable enableDualClassDeepCheck (v2 plan).

SPELL_LIST_INCOMPLETE.Title: Caster has no spells
SPELL_LIST_INCOMPLETE.Hint: Character has a spellcasting entry but no spells.

BACKGROUND_SKILL_NOT_TRAINED.Title: Background skill not trained
BACKGROUND_SKILL_NOT_TRAINED.Hint: {background} grants trained {skill}, but the character is not trained in it.

SPELL_TRADITION_MISMATCH.Title: Spell tradition mismatch
SPELL_TRADITION_MISMATCH.Hint: {spell} has tradition {spellTraditions}, which differs from the entry's {entryTradition}. This may be intentional (e.g. Elf Otherworldly Magic); review if not.

GRADUAL_BOOSTS_ENABLED.Title: Gradual Boosts enabled
GRADUAL_BOOSTS_ENABLED.Hint: Skipping strict 4-per-level boost check; review manually.

LEGACY_SOURCE_FIELD.Title: Legacy source field on {count} item(s)
LEGACY_SOURCE_FIELD.Hint: Re-drag from compendium to populate publication.title.

HP_UNDER_EXPECTED.Title: Max HP below baseline
HP_UNDER_EXPECTED.Hint: Computed max HP {actual} is below the baseline ancestry + (class + CON) × level = {baseline}. Maybe a level-up was skipped.

LEVEL_UP_PENDING.Title: Level-up pending
LEVEL_UP_PENDING.Hint: Character has {xp} XP (threshold {threshold}) but is still level {level}.

STARTING_WEALTH_EXCEEDED.Title: Starting wealth exceeds 15 gp
STARTING_WEALTH_EXCEEDED.Hint: Level-1 characters start with at most 15 gp; this actor has {gp} gp. Ignore if starting at a higher level.

CLASS_FEATURES_MISSING.Title: No class features
CLASS_FEATURES_MISSING.Hint: Actor has no items of category 'classfeature'. Re-drag the class — PF2e auto-grants level-1 features.

CLASS_FEATURES_MISSING_SPECIFIC.Title: Missing {count} class features
CLASS_FEATURES_MISSING_SPECIFIC.Hint: Per the class definition: {names}. Drag them from the compendium.

RANK_BEHIND_PROGRESSION.Title: {stat} proficiency below class progression at level {level}
RANK_BEHIND_PROGRESSION.Hint: Class table expects {expectedRank} at this level, but the character is at {actualRank}. Bump the rank on the Skills/Saves tab or accept the gap if intentional.

RANK_AHEAD_OF_PROGRESSION.Title: {stat} proficiency exceeds class progression at level {level}
RANK_AHEAD_OF_PROGRESSION.Hint: Class table allows at most {expectedRank} at this level, but the character is at {actualRank}. The PF2e system does not block over-ranking; reduce the rank unless granted by a feat/archetype.

SKILL_RANK_TOO_HIGH_FOR_LEVEL.Title: {skill} rank {rank} requires level {minLevel}
SKILL_RANK_TOO_HIGH_FOR_LEVEL.Hint: Universal proficiency rule: Expert needs level 3+, Master 7+, Legendary 15+. Character is level {characterLevel}.

ITEM_LEVEL_EXCEEDS_CHARACTER.Title: Item level too high: {itemName} (L{itemLevel})
ITEM_LEVEL_EXCEEDS_CHARACTER.Hint: Item level {itemLevel} exceeds character level {characterLevel} + 2 tolerance. Verify the item is appropriate; consumables are exempt.

INVESTITURE_OVER_LIMIT.Title: Too many invested items ({count}/10)
INVESTITURE_OVER_LIMIT.Hint: PF2e allows up to 10 invested items at once. Uninvest extras to gain their benefits.

RUNE_DUPLICATE.Title: Duplicate/conflicting rune on {itemName}
RUNE_DUPLICATE.Hint: Multiple fundamental or property runes of type {runeType} detected. Each item allows one of each fundamental rune; property runes must be distinct.

RUNE_LEVEL_EXCEEDS_CHARACTER.Title: Rune above character level on {itemName}
RUNE_LEVEL_EXCEEDS_CHARACTER.Hint: Rune {runeName} requires item level {runeLevel}, but character is level {characterLevel}. OK for loot, flag for review.

ABP_RUNE_CONFLICT.Title: ABP active but {itemName} carries fundamental runes
ABP_RUNE_CONFLICT.Hint: Automatic Bonus Progression is on; fundamental runes are redundant. Remove potency/striking/resilient runes from gear.

TREASURE_BY_LEVEL_LOW.Title: Wealth below curve: {totalGp} gp (expected ~{expectedGp})
TREASURE_BY_LEVEL_LOW.Hint: Character at level {characterLevel} has under 50% of the GMC Character Wealth by Level guidance.

TREASURE_BY_LEVEL_HIGH.Title: Wealth above curve: {totalGp} gp (expected ~{expectedGp})
TREASURE_BY_LEVEL_HIGH.Hint: Character at level {characterLevel} has over 200% of the GMC Character Wealth by Level guidance.

CLERIC_DOMAIN_COUNT_OFF.Title: Cleric domain count mismatch
CLERIC_DOMAIN_COUNT_OFF.Hint: Cleric has {actual} domain(s) but {expected} were expected from feats.

PARTY_SKILL_COVERAGE_GAP.Title: Party missing trained {skill}
PARTY_SKILL_COVERAGE_GAP.Hint: No party member is trained in {skill}.

PARTY_SAVES_VULNERABILITY.Title: Party {save} saves are weak
PARTY_SAVES_VULNERABILITY.Hint: Average {save} modifier is {avgMod} for a level {level} party — below floor. Encounters targeting this save will be deadly.

NPC_LEVEL_OUT_OF_RANGE.Title: NPC level out of range
NPC_LEVEL_OUT_OF_RANGE.Hint: Level {level} is outside PF2e standard range (-1 to 25).

NPC_MISSING_TRAITS.Title: NPC missing traits
NPC_MISSING_TRAITS.Hint: {name} has no creature traits. Add alignment, size, creature type, etc.

NPC_AC_HP_OUT_OF_BAND.Title: NPC {stat} out of expected band
NPC_AC_HP_OUT_OF_BAND.Hint: Level {level} {stat} is {actual}; Building Creatures benchmark is {expected}.

COMPANION_NO_MASTER.Title: Companion has no master
COMPANION_NO_MASTER.Hint: {name} ({type}) is not linked to a master actor.

COMPANION_LEVEL_MISMATCH.Title: Companion level mismatch
COMPANION_LEVEL_MISMATCH.Hint: {name} is level {companionLevel} but master is level {masterLevel}.

WIELDING_UNTRAINED_WEAPON.Title: Wielding untrained weapon: {weaponName}
WIELDING_UNTRAINED_WEAPON.Hint: Untrained in every applicable proficiency (category/group {weaponGroup}). Untrained attacks take −2.

WEARING_UNTRAINED_ARMOR.Title: Wearing untrained armor: {armorName}
WEARING_UNTRAINED_ARMOR.Hint: Armor category {armorCategory} is untrained — no AC proficiency bonus, plus check penalty.

MISSING_AMMO.Title: No ammunition for {weapon}
MISSING_AMMO.Hint: {weapon} has a reload value but no matching ammo in inventory.

SPELL_SLOTS_PER_RANK_MISMATCH.Title: Spell slot count off at rank {rank}
SPELL_SLOTS_PER_RANK_MISMATCH.Hint: {entryName} has {actual} slot(s) at rank {rank}; class progression expects {expected}.

CANTRIP_COUNT_LOW.Title: Few cantrips known
CANTRIP_COUNT_LOW.Hint: {entryName} knows {actual} cantrip(s); full casters typically have {expected}.

FOCUS_POOL_OVER_FOCUS_SPELLS.Title: Focus pool exceeds owned focus spells
FOCUS_POOL_OVER_FOCUS_SPELLS.Hint: Pool max {poolMax} but only {focusSpellsOwned} focus spell(s) owned.

FOCUS_POOL_OVER_CAP.Title: Focus pool exceeds cap (3)
FOCUS_POOL_OVER_CAP.Hint: Focus pool max is {poolMax}; PF2e caps at 3.

SPELL_TRADITION_TRAIT_MISMATCH.Title: Spell tradition trait conflicts with entry

VOLUNTARY_FLAW_COUNT_WRONG.Title: Voluntary flaw count invalid ({count})
VOLUNTARY_FLAW_COUNT_WRONG.Hint: Voluntary Flaws: take exactly 0 or exactly 2 ability flaws in two different attributes.

VOLUNTARY_FLAW_SAME_ATTRIBUTE.Title: Two voluntary flaws on same attribute ({attribute})
VOLUNTARY_FLAW_SAME_ATTRIBUTE.Hint: Voluntary flaws must hit two DIFFERENT attributes.

VOLUNTARY_FLAW_NO_MATCHING_BOOST.Title: Voluntary flaws without matching free boost
VOLUNTARY_FLAW_NO_MATCHING_BOOST.Hint: Voluntary flaws grant 1 extra free boost at L1 (4+1=5). Found {actual}, expected {expected}.

MANDATORY_FLAW_ON_REMASTER_ANCESTRY.Title: Possibly stale ancestry flaw: {attribute} ({ancestry})
MANDATORY_FLAW_ON_REMASTER_ANCESTRY.Hint: Remaster removed mandatory ability flaws from {ancestry}. May be legacy data — not a violation.

CLASS_FEATURE_NOT_PRESENT.Title: Missing class feature: {feature} (L{level})
CLASS_FEATURE_NOT_PRESENT.Hint: {classSlug} characters auto-gain {feature} at level {level}, but no matching item is present.

KEY_ABILITY_NOT_SET.Title: Key Ability not selected
KEY_ABILITY_NOT_SET.Hint: Class {classSlug} offers a choice of Key Ability but none is selected.

CLERIC_DOMAIN_SPELL_COUNT_OFF.Title: Cleric domain spell count mismatch
CLERIC_DOMAIN_SPELL_COUNT_OFF.Hint: Expected {expected} domain focus spells (Domain Initiate {domainInitiate} + Advanced Domain {advancedDomain}), found {actual}. Either add the matching focus spell or the missing feat.

enablePublicationAudit.Name: Enable Publication Audit
enablePublicationAudit.Hint: Scan every item for its publication source.

enableCompletenessAudit.Name: Enable Completeness Audit
enableCompletenessAudit.Hint: Check boosts, languages, feat slots, skill increases.

publicationWhitelist.Name: Publication Whitelist (JSON array)
publicationWhitelist.Hint: Titles to always treat as compliant, e.g. ["My Homebrew"]

treatLegacySourceAs.Name: Legacy source field handling
treatLegacySourceAs.Hint: Severity when an item only has system.source.value, not publication.title.

enableDualClassDeepCheck.Name: Dual Class deep check (v2)
enableDualClassDeepCheck.Hint: v1 only emits a warning; deep check planned for v2.

showDeadActors.Name: Include dead actors in party audit
showDeadActors.Hint: By default, HP=0 members are skipped.

auditButtonOnSheet.Name: Show audit button on character sheet
auditButtonOnSheet.Hint: Client-only; hide the header button per user.

allowPlayerAudit.Name: Allow players to trigger audits
allowPlayerAudit.Hint: Off by default; only the GM can audit.

autoAuditOnLevelUp.Name: Auto-audit on level-up
autoAuditOnLevelUp.Hint: When a character's level changes, automatically run the audit and whisper a summary to the GM.

enableEquipmentAudit.Name: Enable equipment audit
enableEquipmentAudit.Hint: Audit runes, investiture, item-level vs character, and treasure-by-level.

enableSpellAudit.Name: Enable spell-detail audit
enableSpellAudit.Hint: Check spell-slot counts, cantrip count, focus pool, and per-spell tradition mismatches.

customAuditRules.Name: Custom audit rules (JSON)
customAuditRules.Hint: Array of { code, severity, title, hint, when:{predicates} }. See module docs.

watchModeActive.Name: Watch mode (live audit)
watchModeActive.Hint: Re-run audit automatically whenever actor or owned-item data changes.

CustomRules.ParseError: Custom audit rules: invalid JSON, ignoring.
